  "ease_of_use_rating": 4,

  "overall_rating": 4,
  "value_for_money_rating": 4,
  "customer_support_rating": 4,
  "recommendation_score": 8,
  "pros": [
    "Significantly improved lead tracking and sales process visualization compared to previous tools.",
    "Intuitive drag-and-drop interface made it easy to manage deals through stages.",
    "Effective activity scheduling and reminders ensured no opportunities were missed."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and customization required some learning curve for a small team.",
    "Reporting features could be more robust for deeper analytical insights.",
    "Integration with specific construction-related project management tools was not seamless."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Managing Director found Pipedrive to be a substantial upgrade for organizing and tracking leads within their construction business. The visual pipeline and activity management features were particularly beneficial for moving deals from first contact to close. While some advanced reporting and specific industry integrations could be improved, the core functionality significantly streamlined their sales operations."
}
